title.narrative: Building Capacity to Facilitate the Integration of the National Adaptation Planning Process in Ethiopia

description.narrative: Active

Ethiopia’s National Adaptation Plan (NAP-ETH, 2017) builds on ongoing efforts to address climate change in the country’s development policy framework, including the Climate Resilient Green Economy (CRGE) strategy and the second Growth and Transformation Plan (GTP II), as well as sectoral climate resilience strategies and regional and municipal adaptation plans. Addressing the NAP-ETH strategic priorities remains critical for realising Ethiopia’s vision of climate resilience. This entails strengthening adaptation capacity to current and future climate risks. Despite efforts to move from a project-focused to a programmatic approach, capacity development efforts to implement integrated climate change adaptation, per the NAP-ETH, has faced challenges due to multiple factors indicated in the below key challenges section.

In line with NAP-ETH, this project aims to pursue further integration of climate change adaptation in development policies and strategies at national/sub-national levels, including macroeconomic and sectoral policies and strategies, and accelerate efforts to mobilize adaptation resources through strengthening the national/sub-national project pipeline(s) .
